agentmail.free_tier: Free: 3 inboxes, 3,000 emails/month (max 100/day), 3GB storage, no card required

discord-api.auth_hint: Authorization: Bot <token> (OAuth2 Bearer only for user-authorized access and adding the bot to servers)

mailgun.notes: Free plan limited to 1 sending domain and 1-day log retention. Official MCP server is local only (npx @mailgun/mcp-server, stdio).

postmark.notes: Strictly transactional-email focused; enforces anti-bulk/anti-spam policy which can suspend accounts sending bulk/marketing mail. Official MCP server is local (npx @activecampaign/postmark-mcp).

sendgrid-twilio.free_tier: Trial: 100 emails/day for 60 days, no card required; paid plan after

stream-getstream-chat-video-api.free_tier: Free tier: Build plan with 1,000 MAU/month and 100 concurrent connections, no card; Maker account gives $100/month credit for teams under 5 people and under $10k monthly revenue

telegram-bot-api.notes: No single official SDK (community libraries only); a self-hosted local Bot API server option removes some file-size limits. Listed MCP server uses a user account via Telethon/MTProto, not the Bot API.

twilio.free_tier: Trial: 100 SMS, 100 WhatsApp, 3,000 emails, 75 voice minutes; no card; one-time on signup, expires after 30 days
twilio.notes: Trial accounts can only message verified numbers; US SMS at scale requires A2P 10DLC registration. Hosted MCP is read-only docs/API-spec search; the executing server is Twilio Labs' npm @twilio-alpha/mcp (alpha).

whatsapp-business-cloud-api.free_tier: Free: non-template (service) messages inside an open 24h customer service window; template messages billed per message (per-message pricing since 2025-07-01)

zoom-api.notes: Server-to-Server OAuth app type is the recommended path for unattended agent use; some features gated behind licensed/paid plans. Official remote MCP servers (streamable HTTP, user OAuth) run at the mcp.zoom.us gateway.

google-maps-platform.free_tier: Free tier: free calls per SKU per month (10K Essentials, 5K Pro, 1K Enterprise), replacing the former $200 monthly credit

ip2location-io.notes: Official MCP server is hosted (X-API-Key header) or local (stdio via uv, env IP2LOCATION_API_KEY). Free plan returns basic fields; proxy/usage-type details need paid plans. Endpoint: GET https://api.ip2location.io/?key=...&ip=...

openrouteservice.notes: Rate limits vary per endpoint (directions vs isochrones vs matrix); self-hosting also possible. api.openrouteservice.org is deprecated for api.heigit.org (10% quota since 2026-08-27, shut off 2026-09-28); keys at account.heigit.org.

openweathermap-api.free_tier: Free tier: 60 calls/min, 1,000,000 calls/month on current weather/forecast
openweathermap-api.notes: One Call API 3.0 is marked deprecated; One Call 4.0 gives the first 1,000 calls/day free, then pay per call.
